bayts.text: And grant me, by the right of the day of ʿArafa and by the right of those who fast on it, the highest gnosis.
O You Who granted me the months and the years, and toward others than me drove what brings moaning,
bless with a blessing that brings the wishes into being for me and leads ʿArafāt and Minā to me,
with a peace that gathers benefits for me through Him Who never ceases to benefit,
upon him whose service raised me without harm and overthrew whoever hated me.
O Allah, O All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), O Great (Al-Kabīr), O You to Whom belong the mightiest and the magnifying,
bless with a blessing that takes away every straitness toward others than me, forever, and it goes,
with a peace that draws clarity, truthfulness for me, safety and fidelity,
upon him whose praise by me and the blessings upon him have removed lapses toward others than me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And raise my word with gratitude to You, Lord, O You Who efface my exile and my wandering.
You have freed me, through You, from (false) lords, and through Muḥammad from secondary causes,
and through Your Book from fabricating words, and through steadfastness from changing,
and through Your guidance from the guidance of others than You, O Enricher Who poured Your bounty upon me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Generous (Al-Karīm), All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ),
bless with a blessing that makes generosity eternal for me, forever, that unties what has been tied,
from all that grieves or harms, O You through Whom no harm has made for me,
with a peace that turns evils toward other than my person, through You, and misfortune,
upon him whose servant You made me, through him, and led pre-eminence to me
by his standing, and guarded my secrets for me through him, without stratagem or delusion.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And break the customs for me in things, O You Who spared me the heat with shades.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O First (Al-Awwal), O Last (Al-Ākhir), O You Who honour me,
bless with a blessing that purifies my life of what is not good, that makes all of me skilful,
with a peace that leads to me one who silences the haters and deniers: truly he has silenced them.
upon Your noble Prophet, my protector, he who has none in creation to match him.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today, without despoiling, my being the light of all the seekers (of knowledge),
and of all the worshippers and ascetics; and grant me precise recitation (tajwīd) with diligence,
and (make me) a proof for whoever befriends me, and drive toward others than me whoever has hated me.
And make my compositions lights that illumine, radiant, by the sanctity of the illumining Light.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And forever bless him with peace on my behalf, as You gave me possession of the best speech.
And make through him my poem with You abiding righteous (deeds), ascending to the Gardens (cf. Qurʾān 18:46).
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ),
bless with a blessing that beautifies for me all that You chose for me with You, O Best Hearer,
with a peace that increases my gladness, upon the announced (Prophet), the bearer of glad tidings.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And toward others than me drive the toil of this world and the harm of the Other; You have granted the second (reward).
To You be my gratitude, without ingratitude, O You Who protected me from loss.
To You be my gratitude for the edifice, O You Who protected me from toil.
To You be my gratitude for the lawful, O You Who protected me from destitution and misguidance.
To You be my gratitude for those who prostrated, O You Who drove toward others than me (whoever) does not prostrate.
To You be my gratitude for those who bowed, O You Who drove toward others than me whoever does not bow.
To You be my gratitude for the homelands, O You Who protected me from Satan.
To You be my gratitude for the passage, O You Who made it a passage of piety.
To You be my gratitude for the good things, in secret, in the open and in the dwellings.
To You be my gratitude for writing, O Sender-down, Who granted me a Book.
To You be my gratitude for the letters that draw piety and recognised good.
To You be my gratitude for composition, O Giver of secrets and of the familiar.
To You be my gratitude for drawing near, O Effacer of aggression and exile.
To You be my gratitude, Lord, from Muḥarram to the close of the Pilgrimage (Dhū l-Ḥijja), the close of the sacred (months).
